title: One WNBA Team Now Outdraws The Whole League
source: Indiana Fever average home attendance: 2022 1,776; 2023 4,067; 2024 17,036 (post-Caitlin Clark draft); 2025 16,560 (widely reported, e.g. Sportsnaut/Yahoo Sports season recaps). WNBA league-wide average attendance: 2022 5,647; 2023 6,608; 2024 9,807; 2025 10,986 (ESPN, WNBA.com season recaps). 2026 figures are partial-season, through the first 59 league games: league average 11,381 (reported record pace); Fever 2026 approximate, consistent with reported individual-game attendance in the 17,000 range this season.
